commit.message:
Fix  mutation and  propagation in YAML resolver

Two bugs in resolve_inherits:

1. The method mutated obj in-place (replacing $inherits with $child_of on
   the original doc_obj hash). When a second object inherited from the same
   parent, it saw the already-mutated version (without $inherits), so the
   parent's own inherited keys were missing from the grandchild's resolved
   output. Fix: build a new hash instead of mutating the original.

2. $parent_of was set on a local ref_obj variable that was discarded after
   resolve_inherits returned, so it never appeared in the resolved document.
   Fix: add a set_parent_of_relationships post-processing pass that walks
   the fully-resolved document and sets $parent_of on each parent object
   based on the $child_of relationships found in its children.
